g.text: One node per released branch ID; arrows follow the documented prefix-parent reconstruction.
53 nodes | 50 non-self edges | 14 nodes with 2+ children | longest DAG path: 5
Three roots are retained; synthetic plotting roots and self loops are omitted. Colours indicate the authors' broad germ-layer decoder.
Source: Calderon et al. (2022), released table_s1_withLineage.xlsx and celltype_list_rna.txt. Preliminary reconstruction.
